title: Second Vatican Council
dek: Of how an old pope called the bishops of the world to Rome, and what they changed.
body: John XXIII opened it in St Peter's Basilica on 11 October 1962 and died before the second session. Paul VI closed it on 8 December 1965.

panels.label: Sixteen Documents
panels.text: Four constitutions, nine decrees and three declarations, on the liturgy, the Church, revelation and the modern world.

panels.label: The Liturgy
panels.text: Latin was kept, but the vernacular was allowed for readings and the people's parts where bishops judged it useful.

panels.label: Other Faiths
panels.text: Religious freedom grounded in human dignity; the Church “rejects nothing that is true and holy” in other religions.
